# does your submission require gpu for evaluation (inflation)?
<!-- yes|no -->
No
<!-- this only applies to inflation, you can use gpu for compression but not require gpu for evaluation -->

# did you include the compression script? and want it to be merged?
<!-- yes|no -->
yes — `compress.sh` / `compress.py` rebuild `archive.zip` **byte-for-byte** (deterministic ZIP_STORED) by re-running the PR #112 ctx entropy coder on the raw inputs in `encoder/`: frozen #101/#95 decoder streams + frozen #110 selector payload + this submission's polished latent payload. The build asserts the member and archive SHA-256.
# is this submission competitive or innovative? explain why
<!-- competitive: better than top #1 submission -->
Beats the current top leaderboard #112 and #127 . Has a Genetic Algorithm inspired sort of approach so I suppose slightly innovative. 
<!-- innovative: it has a novel idea that is not on the leaderboard yet, might not be competitive, but has potential -->

# additional comments
<!-- anything else you want to share -->
Frozen PR #95/#101 HNeRV decoder + PR #112 ctx range coder, both reused unchanged. Contribution: exact-score-gated discrete latent polish. Starting from the #112 (rhnerv_comma) payload, PR #101's 607-byte latent sidecar is folded into the stored 8-bit latent codes, then ~1,565 one-step (+-1, +-2) latent code adjustments are applied, each scored with the official SegNet/PoseNet evaluators through the exact inflate chain and the real re-encoded archive size, and kept only when the exact contest score improves. A single latent adjustment affects only its own frame pair, so candidates are evaluated exactly (600 per batched render), not estimated; the search plateaued after a full sweep of all 33,600 one-step candidates found no improving move. No gradient step touches stored values; decoder weight bytes and the FEC6 selector are byte-identical to upstream; distortion is verified end-to-end. Optimized for CPU run specifically. For more details refer to method.md. (PS: I am also looking for internship)
